name: openmarine-boat-config
description: Config + deploy tooling for the boat's OpenPlotter Pi (openMarine)

scripts.logs: ssh -t openplotter 'sudo journalctl -u stereo-service -u signalk -f -n 80 -o cat'
scripts.logs:gps: ssh -t openplotter 'sudo journalctl -u stereo-service -f -n 200 -o cat | grep --line-buffered -iE "gps|nmea|assist|aiding|ubx|clock"'
scripts.logs:sensors: ssh -t openplotter 'sudo journalctl -u stereo-service -f -n 200 -o cat | grep --line-buffered -iE "imu|mag|enc|i2c|io read"'
